files.title: S.Y.B.Sc. (Cyber and Digital Science)
files.programme: Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) with Major : Cyber and Digital Science

units.title: Introduction to Linux System Administration
units.topics: Overview of Linux Operating System. Role of a Linux System Administrator. Understanding the Linux File System. Basic Shell Commands and Navigation.

units.title: Installation and Configuration
units.topics: Linux Installation Methods. Partitioning and File System Setup. User and Group Management. Network Configuration and Troubleshooting.

units.title: Control Statements and Functions
units.topics: Package Management with APT and YUM. Kernel Updates and System Reboots. Log File Analysis and Troubleshooting. Monitoring System Performance.

units.title: Security and Access Control
units.topics: User Authentication with PAM. Firewalls and IPtables. Secure Shell (SSH) Configuration. Implementing SELinux/AppArmor for Mandatory Access Control.

units.title: Advanced Topics in Linux Administration
units.topics: Automated Task Scheduling with Cron. Virtualization and Containerization (e.g. Docker). File and Directory Permissions. Backup and Recovery Strategies.

units.title: Introduction to C Programming
units.topics: Introduction to Algorithm and Flowcharts, Basics of C: Historical development of C, Structure of C program, Keywords, identifiers, Constants, Variables, Data types, operators, Formatted and unformatted input and output functions.

units.title: Control Structures
units.topics: Decision making structures: If, if-else, Nested if-else, switch, Looping structures: while, do-while, for, Break and Continue.

units.title: Functions
units.topics: Function basics, Function declaration, definition, function call, Parameter passing: call by value, call by reference, Scope of variables, Storage classes, Recursion.

units.title: Arrays and Strings
units.topics: Introduction to Array, One dimensional array: declaration, initialization and operations, Two dimensional array: declaration, initialization and operations, Introduction to String, String operations, String handling functions.

units.title: Introduction to Computers
units.topics: Introduction, Characteristics of Computers, Block diagram of computer, Types of computers, Generations of Computer.

units.title: Computer Hardware & Software
units.topics: Input devices, Output devices, Memory devices: Primary and Secondary memory, Types of software: System software, Application software.

units.title: Operating System and its Services
units.topics: Dos–History, Files and Directories, Internal and External Commands, Batch Files, Types of O.S.

units.title: Internet Network
units.topics: Network definition, Common terminologies: LAN, WAN, Node, Host, Workstation, bandwidth, Interoperability, Network administrator, network security, Network Components: Severs, Clients, Communication Media, Types of network: Peer to Peer, Clients Server

units.title: Introduction to Problem Solving
units.topics: Concept: problem solving, Problem solving techniques: Steps in problem solving, Flowchart, Algorithm.

units.title: Computing in Ancient India: An Overview
units.topics: Indian Knowledge Systems (IKS): An Overview. Indian Perspective of Computing: An introduction. History of Computing in India. Indian contributions to mathematics and astronomy: Baudhayana, Aryabhata, Brahmagupta, Bhaskaracharya.

units.title: Linguistics and Computing in India
units.topics: Panini’s Ashtadhyayi and Formal Language Theory: Sanskrit grammar as a formal system; Concept of generative grammar and its connection to computer science. Pingala’s Chandashastra and Binary Computing: Pingala’s metrics and binary representation, Combinatorics in Chandashastra (Meru Prastara / Pascal's Triangle).

units.title: Computational Logic and Algorithmics in India
units.topics: Indian Logic (Nyaya and Navya-Nyaya): Foundations of Indian logic; Comparison between Indian logic and Western Boolean logic; Relevance to artificial intelligence and formal reasoning. Algorithms in Indian Astronomy (Jyotisha) and Mathematics (Ganita): Algorithms for astronomical calculations and calendar making, Planetary models and computational procedures.

units.title: Knowledge Systems, Architecture and Contemporary Relevance
units.topics: Architectural Computing and Shilpa Shastra: Geometric and mathematical concepts in Vastu and temple architecture. Modern Relevance and Future Directions: Applications of Indian computing ideas in modern AI, NLP, and algorithm design.

units.title: Introduction to Cyber Security
units.topics: Introduction to Cyber Security: Definition, Importance and scope, Basic terminology: threats, vulnerabilities, risks, attacks. Cyber Security Principles: CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), Non-repudiation, Authentication and authorization.

units.title: Basics of Networking and Security
units.topics: Networking Fundamentals: Introduction to networking, OSI model and TCP/IP protocol suite, IP addressing, subnetting, and routing concepts. Network Security Basics: Firewalls, IDS, IPS, VPNs, Wireless network security.

units.title: Cyber Threats and Attacks
units.topics: Common Cyber Threats: Malware, Social engineering attacks, Denial of Service (DoS) and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks. Web Application Security: Common web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF).

units.title: Security Policies, Management and Ethics
units.topics: Security Policies and Procedures: Developing and implementing security policies, Incident response and management, Risk management and assessment. Cyber Ethics and Laws: Ethical issues in cyber security, Cyber laws and regulations (e.g., GDPR, IT Act).

units.title: Introduction to Network Security Concepts
units.topics: Security Services: Confidentiality, Integrity, Authentication, Non-repudiation, Access Control, Availability. Basic Security Concepts: Vulnerabilities, Threats, Assets and Risks. OSI Security Architecture.

units.title: Cryptography and Public Key Infrastructure
units.topics: Symmetric Key Cryptography: DES, AES, Block cipher modes of operation. Asymmetric Key Cryptography: RSA, Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange. Message Authentication and Hash Functions: MD5, SHA. Digital Signatures, PKI, Digital Certificates.

units.title: Network Security Protocols and Systems
units.topics: Network Layer Security: IPSec (AH, ESP). Transport Layer Security: SSL/TLS. Application Layer Security: PGP, S/MIME. Firewalls, Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), Virtual Private Networks (VPNs).

units.title: Wireless and Mobile Device Security
units.topics: Wireless Network Security: IEEE 802.11 security, WEP, WPA, WPA2, WPA3. Mobile Device Security: Threats, MDM, best practices.

units.title: Introduction to Python
units.topics: Features of Python, Python execution model, Data types, Variables, Operators, Expressions, Input/Output functions.

units.title: Control Flow and Functions
units.topics: Conditional statements, Looping structures, Functions, Function arguments, Anonymous functions (lambda), Recursion.

units.title: Data Structures in Python
units.topics: Lists: operations, methods. Tuples: operations, methods. Sets: operations, methods. Dictionaries: operations, methods, dictionary properties, conversion.

units.title: Modules, Packages and File Handling
units.topics: Modules and Packages: Built-in modules, Creating modules, Import statement. File Handling: Opening, reading, writing, closing files, File modes.

units.title: Descriptive Statistics
units.topics: Introduction to Statistics, Population and Sample, Types of Data, Measures of Central Tendency: Mean, Median, Mode.

units.title: Correlation and Regression
units.topics: Bivariate data, Scatter diagram, Karl Pearson's coefficient of correlation, Spearman's rank correlation coefficient, Linear regression.

units.title: Measures of Dispersion
units.topics: Concept and meaning of Measure of dispersion, Requirements of good Measure of dispersion. Types of Measure of Dispersion - Absolute & Relative Measure dispersion

units.title: Probability and Distributions
units.topics: Concept of probability, Random experiments, Sample space, Events, Probability distributions: Binomial, Poisson, Normal distribution.

units.title: Advanced Formulas and Functions
units.topics: Lookup and Reference functions: VLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX, MATCH, XLOOKUP. Logical functions, Financial functions, Text functions.

units.title: Data Analysis and Pivot Tables
units.topics: Importing data, Data validation, Sorting and Filtering, Pivot Tables, Pivot Charts, Slicers, What-If Analysis, Data Tables.

units.title: Data Visualization and Dashboards
units.topics: Advanced Charting techniques, Sparklines, Conditional Formatting, Building interactive dashboards.

units.title: Macros and Automation Basics
units.topics: Introduction to Macros, Recording and running macros, Introduction to VBA editor, Automating repetitive tasks.

units.title: Introduction to Ethical Hacking
units.topics: What is Ethical Hacking? Confidentiality Integrity Availability (C.I.A) Triad, Cybersecurity Threats & Attack Vectors, Types of Hackers, Ethical Hacking vs. Cybercrime, Ethical Hacking Process

units.title: Foot printing, Reconnaissance & Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT)
units.topics: Introduction to Reconnaissance, Passive vs. Active Reconnaissance, Introduction To Open Source Intelligence (OSINT), Information Gathering/Footprinting Techniques: WHOIS Lookup, Reverse WHOIS, DNS Enumeration (Nslookup, Dig), Social Media Intelligence Gathering, Shodan & Censys for Internet-wide Scanning

units.title: Network Scanning, Enumeration & Exploitation
units.topics: Understanding Network Scanning (TCP, UDP, SYN, ACK), Using Nmap & Advanced Nmap Scripting Engine, OS Fingerprinting & Service Detection, Enumerating Network Services (NetBIOS, SNMP, SMB), Identifying Open Ports and Vulnerable Services, Evading Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) & Firewalls, Network Traffic Analysis (Wireshark), ARP Spoofing & MITM Attacks

units.title: Vulnerability Assessment & System Hacking
units.topics: Introduction to Vulnerability Scanning, Automated vs. Manual Vulnerability Analysis, Vulnerability Scanning Tools: Nessus, OpenVAS, Nikto (for Web Servers), Password Cracking Techniques: Hash Cracking (John the Ripper, Hashcat), Windows Password Extraction/reset, Brute Force & Dictionary Attacks, Privilege Escalation Techniques (Windows & Linux)

units.title: Web Application Hacking & Exploitation
units.topics: Introduction to Web Vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10), SQL Injection (SQLi) - Manual & Automated Exploitation, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) - Reflected, Stored & DOM-Based, Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Remote File Inclusion (RFI) & Local File Inclusion (LFI), Exploiting Content Management Systems (CMS), Web Shell Injection & Command Execution, Bypassing Web Application Firewalls (WAF)
